During the course of the evidence at the inquest it became apparent that detailed assessments of the needs of very vulnerable and perhaps elderly patients are being carried out over the telephone. In this particular case, it lead to the deceased confirming that he was able to dress himself and that he was eating and drinking regularly. This was far from the correct position. I believe that consideration should be given to put in place a system whereby all assessments are carried out face-to-face
assessments of vulnerable elderly patients conducted over the telephone
